capabilityBoundary.classification: BOUNDED EXPERT CAPABILITY LIMIT — AUTONOMOUS DRIVER-ROLE ASSIGNMENT NOT ACCEPTED FOR v1.0
capabilityBoundary.safetyClassification: CAPABILITY FAILURE, NOT UNSAFE PRODUCT ESCAPE
capabilityBoundary.humanConfirmationRequiredWhere: the continuation-controlling versus follow-up distinction materially decides whether work stops, holds, continues with controls, or continues while a separate follow-up remains open
capabilityBoundary.h6ArchitecturalFinding: a model-generated structured justification for a driver role does not establish that the role it justifies is semantically correct
capabilityBoundary.reopeningRule: only after a material intelligence or architecture change; a new instrument must be designed from first principles and §254 may never be reused as a tuning set

deployment.autoDeploy: yes, trigger=commit, branch=main -- A COMMIT TO main IS A PRODUCTION DEPLOY

1_expertCapability.title: Autonomous driver-role classification is not accepted for v1.0
1_expertCapability.evidence: §254 role-presence coherence 2/6 admission-aware and 4/6 on raw output, against a frozen floor of 5/6. Closed by §255 as a bounded limit.

1_expertCapability.title: Expert HazLenz has no production caller
1_expertCapability.evidence: runExpertHazLenzAnalysis is invoked by scripts only; no controller, route or service under src/ calls it. §246 made it production-CALLABLE and nothing has made it production-CALLED, so the validated path cannot be reached by a user.

1_expertCapability.title: Delivered-analysis yield is 3/6 on fresh well-formed observations
1_expertCapability.evidence: §254 refused 3 of 6 analyses outright. The refusals are correct and fail-closed, but a user would receive no analysis half the time. Causes: H3 declaration-coverage self-consistency, H4 exact self-reference of a discharging control, H5 role/candidate-state contradiction. Only H5 is a driver-role defect, so the other two survive the §255 human-confirmation boundary.

1_expertCapability.title: The verifier leg has never been exercised against Candidate v2.3
1_expertCapability.evidence: §254 ran first-pass only by frozen spend design; the verifier was reached on 0 of 6. The §218 verifier contract is wired into the entry point but unmeasured on this candidate.

1_expertCapability.title: dischargingControlRef transmitted-null / projection-refusal gap
1_expertCapability.evidence: Carried from §252 and §253, not materially encountered in §254, and distinct from the role-capability result.

2_safeHumanBeta.title: No human-confirmation surface for consequential driver-role classification
2_safeHumanBeta.evidence: The §255 boundary requires the continuation-controlling versus follow-up distinction to be human-confirmed where it decides whether work stops, holds or continues. No such flow exists in frontend-next, and the backend result contract carries no confirmation state. §255 authorizes the boundary, not the implementation.

2_safeHumanBeta.title: Fail-closed behaviour pending confirmation is unimplemented
2_safeHumanBeta.evidence: Nothing yet prevents an unconfirmed classification being presented as an operational conclusion, because no consumer exists. Must be built with B1 and must never infer confirmation from silence.

2_safeHumanBeta.title: Expert is not customer-active and the product default is the legacy path
2_safeHumanBeta.evidence: customerDefaultMode=LEGACY, productionShadowEnabled=false. Deterministic HazLenz remains the sole customer-authoritative path.

2_safeHumanBeta.title: Deployed code is behind local main and the worktree is large and uncommitted
2_safeHumanBeta.evidence: deployed 45251d38a4e8, local HEAD 37a5d1b50abe, 2 commits ahead, 812 uncommitted worktree entries. autoDeploy=yes, trigger=commit, branch=main -- A COMMIT TO main IS A PRODUCTION DEPLOY, so a commit to main is a production deploy while migrations are applied out of band. Beta needs a controlled release plan before any commit.

2_safeHumanBeta.title: The canonical current-state readiness statement is stale
2_safeHumanBeta.evidence: docs/INSITE_CURRENT_STATE.json readiness still describes the pre-§243 formal evaluation and its M14/M10 gate failures. It predates §243 through §255 and would misinform anyone reviewing beta readiness from the authoritative document.

3_productPolish.title: Stale architectural comment in the semantic transport
3_productPolish.evidence: expert-semantic-transport.ts still explains why the strict flag cannot be dropped. Behaviour is correct because the flag comes from the envelope, but the envelope now binds strict=FALSE and the comment reads as an invariant that no longer holds.

3_productPolish.title: Historical suites carry known-failing assertions
3_productPolish.evidence: test-249 (P2,P4,P5,P7), test-246 (F1,F4,F6,E3b) and test-expert-anthropic-adapter-repair (A.19) fail by design under the accepted architecture. Ruled and classified, but a new engineer running the suites sees red.

3_productPolish.title: Frozen TypeScript provenance error
3_productPolish.evidence: expert-237-posture-contract.ts(193,47) TS2552 POSTURE_REF_KINDS_237, deliberately unrepaired since §239 to keep the frozen chain reproducible.

4_infrastructureBillingStorageUpdates.title: Expert unit economics are unmanaged
4_infrastructureBillingStorageUpdates.evidence: §254 measured 43713 input tokens and USD 0.1123 per analysis. Input tokens dominate and prompt caching is not configured (cache_control in the envelope: false). No per-tenant spend cap or budget control is evidenced on the Expert path.

4_infrastructureBillingStorageUpdates.title: Single free-plan backend instance
4_infrastructureBillingStorageUpdates.evidence: safety-insite-backend (srv-d7kl74jeo5us73deaor0), Render, free plan, 1 instance. Cold starts and no redundancy, compounded by Expert calls that take tens of seconds.

4_infrastructureBillingStorageUpdates.title: Deploy and migration ordering hazard
4_infrastructureBillingStorageUpdates.evidence: deployRunsMigrations=false with autoDeploy=yes, trigger=commit, branch=main -- A COMMIT TO main IS A PRODUCTION DEPLOY. Code ships on commit; schema does not.

4_infrastructureBillingStorageUpdates.title: Production object storage provisioning is not evidenced
4_infrastructureBillingStorageUpdates.evidence: Storage is S3-backed and the local provider throws in production, which is correct. Whether STORAGE_S3_BUCKET and credentials are configured in production is not established by anything in the repository. Verify before beta.

4_infrastructureBillingStorageUpdates.title: Billing live configuration is not evidenced
4_infrastructureBillingStorageUpdates.evidence: Plans, entitlements, subscription status and Stripe customer identifiers exist in src/billing. Whether live keys, products and webhooks are configured in production is not established by anything in the repository. Verify before beta.

5_legalPrivacyClaims.title: The product claims register predates §254 and needs a §255 amendment
5_legalPrivacyClaims.evidence: docs/PRODUCT-CLAIMS-REGISTER.md already classifies "autonomous" as NOT_CURRENTLY_SUPPORTABLE and "expert" as not supportable externally; §254 now corroborates both with direct measurement. The permissible characterization §255 sets out must be recorded there before any beta-facing copy is written.

5_legalPrivacyClaims.title: Name and trademark clearance not performed
5_legalPrivacyClaims.evidence: The register marks both "HazLenz" and "Safety InSite" LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Engineering has no view and cannot close this.

5_legalPrivacyClaims.title: Third-party model disclosure and data-processing position
5_legalPrivacyClaims.evidence: Reasoning is performed by ["claude-sonnet-5"]. Observation text leaves the product to a third-party provider. Subprocessor disclosure, a DPA and the customer consent posture are required before real workplace observations are sent.

5_legalPrivacyClaims.title: "HazLenz AI" is the most-used claim and attaches to third-party reasoning
5_legalPrivacyClaims.evidence: Register section A: 57 occurrences, SUPPORTABLE_WITH_QUALIFICATION. The qualification has not been applied to the copy.

6_knownAcceptedLimitations.title: dischargingControlRef contract-consistency gap carried forward (§253, §255)
6_knownAcceptedLimitations.evidence: Non-blocking absent observed consequence; not encountered in §254.

6_knownAcceptedLimitations.title: Historical suites superseded by the strict flag and by the §253 schema head
6_knownAcceptedLimitations.evidence: Ruled in §252 and §255 under narrow, explicitly bounded supersession rules.
